##### Project General Facts

Virdis boasts a sophisticated design aesthetic, featuring striking exteriors that embody the essence of refined living, with luxurious spaces designed for today's young professionals. The Virdis serviced apartments, set in Towers A and B, present the perfect opportunity for a ready-to-move-in home, with an easy investment process and fantastic price point, offering a range of studio, one-, and two-bedroom residential apartments. The townhouses and apartments showcase ultimate comfort and convenience, serene spaces to call your own, as well as a world of fun and excitement that's just a stone's throw away.

Virdis features an array of amenities, including a state-of-the-art gym, pool, and spa, which provide a holistic living experience that caters to the needs of its residents. The emphasis on outdoor spaces and lush living areas creates a unique and desirable living environment, with an abundance of space for creating cherished memories. The private gardens and community views offer a tranquil oasis, perfect for unwinding and enjoying quality time with loved ones, while the world-class facilities with a wide range of amenities ensure that residents have exactly what they're looking for.

The interior finishing of Virdis showcases elegant textures and state-of-the-art facilities, complemented by a timeless design that incorporates fresh, warm tones and calm, relaxed atmospheres, which create a sense of serenity and tranquility. The kitchens are masterpieces of design, with an emphasis on functionality and elegance, featuring state-of-the-art appliances and modern finishing with high-quality materials, making them the perfect space for cooking and entertainment.

##### Location description and benefits

Damac Hills 2 is a strategic location that allows easy access to four major highways, including Emirates Road, Al Qudra Road, and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, making it an ideal location for those who want to be connected to the city. The location is also close to several major landmarks, including the Dubai Mall, Mall of the Emirates, and the Arabian Ranches, providing residents with a wide range of shopping, dining, and entertainment options. The nearby Dubai International Airport and Al Maktoum International Airport make it easy to travel to and from the location.

Damac Hills 2 offers a unique blend of natural beauty and urban convenience, with lush greenery and wholesome surroundings that create a sense of belonging for all. The location is also close to several major attractions, including the Dubai Miracle Garden, the Butterfly Garden, and the Global Village, making it an ideal location for those who want to experience the best of Dubai. The nearby Polo Club and Dubai Hills also provide opportunities for outdoor activities and sports, making Damac Hills 2 a vibrant and exciting location to live.

The community at Damac Hills 2 is designed to create countless experiences and a sense of luxury living, with a wide range of activities and amenities available, including the Outdoor Cinema, Fishing Lake, and Farmers Market. The location is also close to several major business hubs, including Dubai Investments Park and Dubai Studio City, making it an ideal location for professionals and entrepreneurs. The nearby Academic City and Silicon Oasis also provide access to top-notch educational and technological facilities, making Damac Hills 2 a great location for those who want to live, work, and play in a vibrant and dynamic community.
